slides.title: Getting more from every kilogram, on today's lines and the new ones
slides.subtitle: UFlex Limited
slides.footnote: Prepared from UFlex disclosures up to Q1 FY27 and public industry sources. Figures will be refreshed after the Q2 FY27 results.

slides.title: Commit ₹18 cr first, and roll out only when one line clears its own break-even

tiles.line: Stage 1: one pilot line, inventory planning, recycling quality, Dharwad instrumentation
of film output removed as scrap on the pilot line: where the roll-out pays for itself
recurring benefit in year 5 (base); ₹14 cr after the programme's own running cost

slides.strap: One-off value comes on top: about ₹61 cr of inventory cash and ₹8 cr from faster ramp-up of new lines.
slides._source: Source: PLUMB model built on UFlex FY26 Annual Report and Q1 FY27 investor presentation; base case, pre-tax, ₹ crore.

slides.title: UFlex runs the whole chain from resin to pack, so AI can work at every step
slides._source: Source: UFlex Q1 FY27 investor presentation (annual capacities; converting utilisation in Q1 FY27). UC5, inventory and cash forecasting, sits across the group in Stage 1.

slides.title: UFlex already reports AI in six places; the sprint finds out what each delivers
slides._source: Source: UFlex Annual Reports FY25 and FY26. A maturity assessment needs UFlex's people, systems and data, so it is part of the sprint.

slides.title: Four use cases are worth about ₹41 cr a year at full rate, built on tonnes
slides.unit: a year at full rate, base case
slides._source: Source: PLUMB model. UC1: 492,779 t × 0.6% scrap removed × ₹110/kg × 30% value lost, plus 2% energy. UC3 at full recycling utilisation; year 5 reaches ₹34 cr while this ramps.

slides.title: Year 5 is cash-positive in the base case; Gate 2 decides whether years 2 to 5 happen

callout.head: Five-year NPV, pre-tax

rows.label: Base, with steady state after year 5

callout.note: Low case assumes a 25% cost overrun. Build cost charged when spent.

slides.strap: That is why the money is staged: ₹18 cr is committed before anyone knows UFlex's own rates.
slides._source: Source: PLUMB model, base case, ₹ crore, 12% discount rate. EBITDA view excluding capitalisable build is in the full strategy.

slides.title: One data foundation, built once, serves every use case and recycled-content record

items.text: Line controls, OEM services, inspection, lab, energy meters
ERP: orders, stock, purchases in nine countries
Read-only exports by UFlex IT; no remote OT access
One model of site, line, grade, order and roll
Forecasts for stock, cash and FX
Value ledger owned by group finance

slides.legend_note: Security across all layers: IEC 62443 segmentation before any integration.
slides._source: Source: PLUMB reference architecture. Vendors are chosen by UFlex; PLUMB takes no fees from technology vendors.

slides.title: Three gates decide each next commitment, with group finance signing the results

cards.head: Gate 1 · week 2
cards.text: A line and a problem chosen, the data agreed, and installed tools listed

cards.head: Gate 2 · month 10
cards.text: Pilot line against a control: 1.02% scrap removed, 3.4% energy saved

cards.head: Gate 3 · month 18
cards.text: India sites tracking measured rates before any overseas roll-out

slides._source: Below the Gate 2 line, UFlex keeps the enterprise use cases and the data foundation, and does not roll out the film-line work.

slides.title: The first step is a two-week sprint on one line and one problem UFlex chooses

outputs.text: Installed AI and line tools listed
Data check for the chosen problem

slides.ask: A short session with film technical leadership to choose the line and the problem. The sprint has a fixed fee; UFlex owns the deliverables and is not obliged to continue.
slides._source: Working days. Data is read-only and exported by UFlex IT; nothing connects to plant networks.

slides.title: PLUMB Advisory: independent AI strategy, measured on results

lines.text: Independent: no reseller, referral or implementation fees from any technology vendor
Fixed fee for the sprint; pilot fees capped, with part held back until Gate 2 is signed off
